title: AMP Game Server
tagline: Powerful Game Server Management Panel in Docker for ZimaOS
description:
CubeCoders AMP (Application Management Panel) is a powerful, web-based management system designed specifically for hosting and managing dedicated game servers (Minecraft, Source games, Rust, Valheim, and more) directly on ZimaOS.

### Features:
- **Multi-Game Support:** Manage multiple game servers from a single dashboard.
- **Automated Management:** Built-in server updates, automated backups, and scheduled restarts.
- **Web Interface:** Full-featured web GUI on port 8080.
- **Dockerized Execution:** Isolated and containerized instance environment using Docker socket access.
author: kerklangsi
release_notes:
### What's New in v1.0.0
- Initial release of CubeCoders AMP container for ZimaOS App Store.
- Preconfigured Docker socket binding and persistent storage for server data.

tips.before_install: Ensure host ports 8080 (Web UI) and 7777 (UDP) are free. Container requires access to Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock).
tips.after_install: Open the AMP Web Interface at http://<your-zimaos-ip>:8080 to complete the initial setup wizard and create your first game server instance.
